definitions.domain: Exact input finite silicon material mask; all time, without tail renormalization
definitions.M_i: integral (r_i-r0_i) dQ over finite Si and all time
definitions.M_ij: integral (r_i-r0_i)(r_j-r0_j) dQ over finite Si and all time
definitions.M_t: integral ((t-epoch_s)/1e-12) dQ over finite Si and all time
definitions.M_tt: integral ((t-epoch_s)/1e-12)^2 dQ over finite Si and all time
definitions.source_present: 1 for this explicitly prescribed positive alpha source; missing inputs or failed integration never become zero
definitions.normalization: None: charge-weighted raw moments, never divide features by Q
definitions.zero_interpretation: An explicitly supported zero source would have all-zero raw features and null explanatory moments; this alpha v2 builder currently accepts amplitude 1 only

kernel.spatial: Piecewise-linear original ASTAR-derived electronic line charge on actual finite ray-box path 0<=s<=L, times exp(-(u^2+v^2)/w^2)/(pi*w^2), w=0.05um, in orthonormal ray coordinates; finite perpendicular axial end planes; no longitudinal convolution
kernel.temporal: Common prescribed epoch 15ns, Gaussian sigma=0.2ps; relative first moment 0 and second moment Q*sigma_ps^2 at double precision; no along-track flight-time model
kernel.energy: At modeled Si surface, 3/5/7MeV; piecewise linear Se(E), Sn(E) from bound original ASTAR; exact interval integration of dE/ds=-rho*1e-4*(Se+Sn); charge from Se only, rho=2.33g/cm^3, 3.6eV/pair
kernel.geometry: gate_top_depth_nm=70/80/90 and sn_junction_depth_nm=82/87/92; current exact BCAT finite Si material mask and input doping agreement required
kernel.direction: theta=0/30deg from +z, phi=180deg; d=(-sin(theta),0,cos(theta)), e_u=(cos(theta),0,sin(theta)), e_v=(0,1,0)
kernel.material_proof: Centerline must be proven entirely Silicon by exact ray-box endpoints, x<-outer_trench_radius and y=0 in active; otherwise reject. Gaussian non-Si tails are clipped, not propagated through oxide or converted to Si charge.

numerics.feature_refinement_gate: abs(delta)<=100*normalized_absolute*max(1,allocated_charge_fC)+10*relative*abs(refined_value), with numbers expressed in each declared feature unit
numerics.lut_charge_gate: abs(Q_LUT-Q_CSDA)<=max(1e-6fC,0.001*Q_CSDA), inherited from original alpha offline mapping criterion
numerics.interpretation: Quadrature repeatability and profile-resolution comparisons are numerical evidence, not rigorous error bounds or native source qualification

permitted_inputs: Input model and analytic material geometry
Deterministically derived profile, source contract and includes
scope: Conditional device-response surrogate given prescribed source summary and device conditions; Si-surface alpha model only, no commercial stack propagation or population risk. V2 is not registered with the v1 dispatcher or device/data admission by this implementation.
